abstract.para: Learn about key features of &sles4sap; that automate the deployment of &sap; workloads.

topic.para: &sles4sapa; provides software patterns that are tailored to specific &sap; workloads and scenarios. These patterns install the required &suse; packages and handle the initial configuration of your system: basic &sap; tuning parameters through &saptune;, and &selnx; with dedicated &sap; rules, automatically set to permissive mode. You can select which patterns to install both during and after the installation of the operating system.
After the base operating system is configured, you can use &suse; supported &ansible; roles to automate the deployment and management of your &sap; landscapes.
